title: Nexora SAGE Release Validation Dependency Contract

dependency_input_roles.description: Optional exact direct-dependency role map. Only reviewed v1 blocking prerequisite_only can exclude a predecessor digest; absent, unclassified or unsupported roles retain full evidence.

source_text_only_paths.description: Reviewed exact-path Python files read as text, not import roots. Their full bytes remain hashed. Any actual import of one from an executable root is still traversed.

startup_configuration_tree.description: Conservative full config/ file content and directory-membership identity, with confined doctrine members and refusal of external target context. Not an atomic or hostile-filesystem snapshot.

version.description: Only v1 is projected. Unsupported versions retain full dependency evidence.
